skill_line: Read and follow the skill at {skill}/SKILL.md, and every reference file it says to read, as though it were in this project's AGENTS.md.

evals.prompt: {skill_line}We're working towards the 1.0 release (see issues.md). Start with the issues most related to Basket.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator sees the red trunk in ci/trunk.txt, looks only as far as a brief needs, and spawns an agent to make trunk green before the Basket issues, editing nothing and running no test itself.
assertions: [The orchestrator does no work] No edit, file write, test run, commit, or push by the orchestrator before its first spawn
[Delegate once the brief can be written] The orchestrator spawns an agent
[A red trunk comes first] The first agent spawned is briefed on the red trunk
[Look only as far as a brief needs] At most 8 tool calls before the first spawn

evals.expected_output: The orchestrator briefs an agent to fix issue #3, after reading no more than the brief needs, and edits nothing and runs no test itself.
assertions: [The orchestrator does no work] No edit, file write, test run, commit, or push by the orchestrator before its first spawn
[Delegate once the brief can be written] The orchestrator spawns an agent
[Look only as far as a brief needs] At most 8 tool calls before the first spawn

evals.prompt: {skill_line}How many of the open issues in issues.md are about Basket?
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator answers 2 from issues.md, and spawns no agent and changes nothing.
assertions: [Answer a question] The final answer says 2
[Answer a question] The orchestrator spawns no agent
[The orchestrator does no work] No edit, file write, test run, commit, or push
